caption: A square of 60 men about-faces and reforms in place. Its short rear rank is now in front, so four men of the old front rank keep their file and walk the depth of the square to its far end. Each of them now swings out round his own flank while the rest of the square stands fast. Before this fix the square chose those men by roster order: three men who should have stood still were sent out beside the square, and one of the four walked straight through it.
